AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator account mapped to a Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin record was created.

Voucher.title: Voucher
Voucher.description: Single-use subscription or trial extension voucher code issued by admin and redeemable once without login.

code.description: Unique voucher or SmartStore order code matching the document ID.

value.description: Number of trial days granted (or 365 for full subscription pass).

title.description: Display label for the voucher pass.

orderNote.description: Non-PII admin note such as SmartStore batch or channel label.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who issued this voucher.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the voucher was created.

usedAt.description: Server timestamp when the voucher was redeemed.

redeemedBy.description: Opaque device member ID that redeemed this voucher.

/vouchers/{voucherId}.description: Single-use voucher codes verified and redeemed atomically via Firestore transactions.
